newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 113 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 113 bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued on Thursday certificates of deposit dated March 14 to commercial banks worth 113 billion Lebanese pounds.
The bank sold 60-day certificates worth 94 billion pounds at 13 percent annual interest and 45-day CDs worth 19 billion pounds at 12.25 percent.
Last week the Bank sold 60-day CDs worth 63 billion pounds and 45-day CDs worth five billion pounds. Interest rates were unchanged on the week.
